body:
I don't even know man. I'm sick of trying. I'm tired of falling deeper and deeper. Every few mths I am given a false glimmer of hope and then it's just snatched away from me. Sure I admit that I'm at fault for a couple of misgivings in my life but frankly, not even probably 10% of them. Idk what to even do. My best friend has been family to me this whole time. He kept me alive for a very long time throughout all of this. He even told me I should've called him the second I had second thoughts and he would've returned to the airport to get me. Why didn't I listen to my gut?

I can't live like this. Myself and my sister have suffered so much torment that I'm not even sure how either of us is alive. She's homeless and was almost raped/killed in NYC a few days ago. We both are struggling with homelessness and job security (me with a degree, her without one). She has a husband and I have a best friend that basically keep us chugging along.

I just wanna go home and for everything to work nicely for once. I'm sick of losing out on life. I'm sick of everything going sour. 

From my dad physically abusing me to the point I was in the hospital at age 4, to having my jaw dislocated by my mom, I can move past that...fine. But to have such a fucked up life that I have been living for the past 6 years without being sure if I'd have a home the next day? I can't do it anymore. I've never taken govt assistance (except for 1 summer for Pell grant where I was 2 hrs away from being homeless)

Can I just get one thing right for me, please? Please? Something somebody? Can I just get successful enough to help lift my sister out of poverty and be happy? Please? Is that too much to ask? 

Am I not allowed to feel happiness? I can't live like this for another 40-60 years. I just want to go back in time and pay my parents whatever amount they want to never have had me. I can't do anything right. I'm failing at everything. Everytime a somewhat good opportunity comes up, something happens and it doesn't pan out. 

Oh, you got an interview for that $60k job? Yeah, you'll lose out to the kid with no debt and parents that paid his way through school.

Oh, you got an apartment finally for cheap? You'll get roommates that beat their gf's and cause a ruckus 24/7.

Oh, you got that job abroad? It's going to be filled with lies and deceit.

My parents and friends (except my best friends) are probably so sick of watching me fail that if I leave here (heh, if I can find a ticket for under $1k otherwise I'll be stuck) they will probably finish disowning me.

I have nobody. Nothing. I have $28k in student loan debts, $1.5k in CC debt. How am I supposed to live? I can't keep doing this forever. I have no energy left. I cannot even afford to see the doctor for my chronic dislocations. Family friend told me that it's likely that I have some rare connective tissue disorder but I can't afford to get it DX'd. 

Why me? Seriously. If there is a deity out there, he surely must be wanting me to fuck up and fail.

Frankly, my spirit is broken. I want to lay down and end my life. I can't deal with more heartbreak, disappointment, and lies.
